options.text: Equanil is used to control depression and hypertension.
Mifepristone is a synthetic steroid used as "moming after pill".
0.2 per cent solution of phenol is an antiseptic while its 1.0 per cent solution is a disinfectant.
A drug which kills the organism in the body is called bacteriostatic.

solution.text: Bacteriostatic drugs inhibit the growth of organisms while bactericidal drugs kill the microorganisms.
